findings.argument: Searches (Aug 2026): (1) Connes–Consani–Marcolli, 'The Weil Proof and the Geometry of the Adeles Class Space' (Manin Festschrift, Birkhäuser 2008; arXiv:math/0703392) already builds a dictionary between the steps of the Weil proof and the adele class space 'with good working notions of correspondences, degree, and codegree' — including Frobenius-type scaling correspondences with the composition law realized by the scaling flow. This is the closest existing axiomatization to the brief's 'polarized Frobenius system' and it is nowhere engaged; a hostile referee of Lemma B will demand the comparison (in particular why CCM's degree/codegree calculus with its known failure of the trivial-correspondence degree-adjustment at the archimedean place does not already contain, or block, the definition). Banaszak–Uetake's operator-theoretic abstract intersection theory (arXiv:0908.2909; on disk as t-30b/t-43b/t-58a and routed to Track-C in corpus-routing.md) is a second unengaged axiomatization of the same target. (2) The Kurokawa absolute tensor product tradition (Kurokawa 1992; Manin, Lectures on zeta functions and motives, Astérisque 228, which explicitly treats 'Z ⊗_F1 Z' via Kurokawa tensor products; Koyama–Kurokawa; Akatsuka, 'The double Riemann zeta function', Comm. Number Theory Phys. 3 (2009) 619–653; arXiv:2008.07752 for Dirichlet L) is the established mathematics of 'the zeta of the square of Spec Z': its Euler product runs over PAIRS of primes and its zeros are SUMS ρ₁+ρ₂ of zeta zeros. This is precisely the bilinear-in-pairs-of-primes data class gate Z5 fears, now with a published calibration: the Z5 gate should add the explicit check that the (p,q)-assembly's colimit reproduces W(f) (single-prime support, zeros ON the line) and not the Kurokawa tensor-square data (pair support, zeros = sums) — the natural failure mode of a pairwise-product family now has a name and a literature. (3) Scholze's ICM-2018 report (Rio.pdf) already pictures Spec A_inf as 'Spec O_C♭ × Spec Z_p' — per-prime self-products as realized pieces of the arithmetic square — and the Feb-2026 arXiv:2602.04978 (global z-adic Hodge theory curves) shows this frontier is moving; the June-2026 CC paper itself ties E_p to the Fargues–Fontaine curve. VERDICT on novelty: no source found proposing classical complex Tate-curve products E_p × E_q with abelian-surface intersection theory and cross-family multiplicativity descent — the seed's specific form appears genuinely new — but the brief's R7(a) list (CC orbit, Haran, vdG–Schoof, Manin F1, Smirnov) must be extended by these three traditions before any novelty claim is published, and Z5 must absorb the Kurokawa calibration.

findings.claim: Lemma B's printed definition omits the effectivity axiom its own step 3 consumes, and the total-multiplicativity axiom silently restricts the admissible Euler shape to degree one — both fixable in the write-up, but a referee will catch both.
findings.argument: The definition (§First deliverable, (i)–(ii)) posits 'a family of correspondences {Ψ_n}' with the composition law and degree-matching; nowhere is Ψ_n required EFFECTIVE. Step 3's mechanism ('nonnegativity because the relevant degrees are intersection numbers of effective correspondences against a nef polarization') is false for general correspondence classes, which are differences of effective ones and can have negative degrees — effectivity must be an axiom or Λ_D(n) ≥ 0 does not follow. Second, Ψ_m∘Ψ_n = Ψ_mn for ALL m,n (not just coprime) makes the fiber-degree data totally multiplicative, hence forces Euler factors of shape (1−a_p p^{−s})^{−1}: right for ζ (a_p=1, Λ(p^k)=log p — and the step-2 claim 'prime-power support + Λ_D(p^k)=f(Λ_D(p),k) by formal monoid algebra' is then genuinely correct and cheap, which I verified by writing out the monoid computation), but it excludes every higher-degree Euler-intact L-function, and it differs from the function-field template the brief invokes, where the Frobenius monoid is generated by ONE prime (F^m, m≥1). The write-up must state this scope restriction explicitly or the axioms misdescribe their own template. Neither point degrades the DH/Epstein kill (with effectivity added, Λ_DH(12)=−0.76<0 and Λ_DH(6)≠0 close the contradiction in one line each); R8's honest fallback (lemma degrades to a definition of admissible D if step 1 cannot avoid circularity) already prices the worst case correctly.

findings.argument: The definition (brief §First Deliverable, clause ii) requires correspondences {Ψ_n} with Ψ_m∘Ψ_n=Ψ_mn, Ψ_p primitive exactly at primes, 'whose degrees against the two fibers reproduce the degree/counting data of an L-series D(s)'. HORN 1 (literal/degree reading — the reading the brief's own step-1 template mandates: 'the char-p model — degrees of graph-of-Frobenius powers on C×C reproducing point counts — is the template'). Counterexample: on X = P¹×P¹ over the proper adelic curve S = (Q, places) with the standard nef adelic bundle O(1,1), take Ψ_n = Γ_n = graph of z↦z^n. Then Γ_m∘Γ_n = Γ_mn exactly for all m,n (commutative), Ψ_1 = Δ, Ψ_p is primitive exactly at primes (p = ab impossible), every Ψ_n is an effective irreducible curve, and the degrees against the two fibers are (1, n) — precisely parallel to the char-p degrees d(Γ_{F^k}) = (1, q^k). Every stated axiom holds verbatim, and NOTHING in the axioms references the coefficients of D: the only stated D-contact is via degree data, so the identical system serves as a 'polarized Frobenius system' for D = ζ, D = DH, or D = Epstein indifferently. Hence 'DH admits no polarized Frobenius system' is false as stated. Independently, the degree reading is internally contradictory even for zeta: bidegrees multiply under composition of correspondences on curve-squares, so the composition law forces the degree data to be COMPLETELY multiplicative (c_mn = c_m·c_n for all m,n); but prime-power support requires c_pq = 0 for distinct p,q while complete multiplicativity gives c_pq = c_p·c_q ≠ 0 whenever two primes carry nonzero data — jointly satisfiable ONLY when at most one prime carries data, i.e. exactly the one-generator char-p monoid. The brief's template is a one-prime template misread as a multi-prime one. Moreover the template sentence itself is factually wrong: in char p the degrees of Γ_{F^k} are (1, q^k) and do NOT reproduce point counts; the counts are N_k = (Γ_{F^k}·Δ) = q^k + 1 − Σα_i^k (Lefschetz) — the difference between degree data and counting data IS the zero side, so a degree-based definition is structurally blind to zeros. HORN 2 (trace reading: counting data = (Ψ_n·Δ)-type numbers). Then proof-obligation step 2 ('Composition law + primitivity ⟹ prime-power support … formal monoid algebra; no analysis') is false: intersection numbers against Δ do not factor through composition — (Ψ∘Φ·Δ) is not a function of (Ψ·Δ),(Φ·Δ) — absent a Lefschetz trace-formula axiom tying composition to traces. In char p that tie is a THEOREM about the existing cohomology; over Q it is exactly the missing substrate (M2). Adding it as an axiom ('the counting data of D are trace-organized by the monoid') makes the D-attachment Euler-organized BY DEFINITION, so DH's exclusion follows from the definition plus the one-line coefficient witnesses — the geometry contributes nothing checkable. I verified in my own model: (Γ_n·Δ) = n+1 on P¹×P¹ (fixed points of z^n = z: (n−1)+2, Lefschetz-consistent), i.e. the trace reading pins the system to the zero-free D = ζ_{P¹}; realizing any D with zeros requires H¹-substance = the missing square, so the trace-reading 'lemma' has no provable-today content beyond the coefficient witnesses. findings.claim: The Tate-curve E_p×E_q seed (M2b, commission asset 3, the 'genuinely new substrate option') is void: the cross-prime correspondence groups vanish, the diagonal does not exist, the fiberwise Hodge-index inequality is vacuous, and the assembled intersection data provably cannot host the explicit formula's linear prime terms. findings.argument: From the tier-1 on-disk extraction of arXiv:2606.06604 (sources-extracted/…fulltext.txt, lines 1518–1596): E_p = C^×/p^Z ≅ C/Λ_p with Λ_p = Z ⊕ Zτ_p, τ_p = i·log p/(2π) (q = 1/p). (1) Hom(E_p, E_q) = 0 for p ≠ q barring a transcendence miracle: a nonzero α with αΛ_p ⊆ Λ_q gives α·1 = a + bτ_q, α·τ_p = c + dτ_q (a,b,c,d ∈ Z); the imaginary part forces a·log p = d·log q, so a = d = 0 (log p/log q rational would give p^u = q^v); the real part then forces b·log p·log q = −4π²c, i.e. an isogeny exists IFF log p·log q ∈ π²·Q — no such relation is known for any pair and none is expected (four-exponentials-type territory). (2) UNCONDITIONAL coherence kill for the brief's own N2 sandbox {E_2×E_3, E_2×E_5, E_3×E_5}: if all three pairs admitted nonzero correspondences, then log2·log3 = π²r₁, log2·log5 = π²r₂, log3·log5 = π²r₃ with r_i ∈ Q, whence log3/log2 = √(r₁r₃/r₂)/√(r₁r₂/r₃) = |r₃/r₂| ∈ Q — contradiction with unique factorization (3^v = 2^u). So at least one cross group is provably zero, and any composition-coherent family over all pairs of primes is unconditionally impossible; generically all cross groups vanish. Since divisorial correspondences E_p ⊢ E_q modulo fiber classes ≅ Hom(E_p,E_q), the off-diagonal surfaces carry ONLY the two fiber classes: NS(E_p×E_q) has rank 2. Consequences, each individually disqualifying: (a) no diagonal Δ exists on E_p×E_q for p ≠ q (E_p ≇ E_q barring the same π²-miracle class), so the target pairing (Ψ_f·Δ) = W(f) has no Δ to pair against; (b) the Castelnuovo–Severi/Hodge-index inequality is VACUOUS on every off-diagonal member: the orthogonal complement of the two fiber classes in a rank-2 hyperbolic NS is zero — the brief's 'the positivity is free fiber-by-fiber' is true only because there is nothing to be positive about; (c) the family is totally disconnected as a category (all comparison maps between distinct fibers are zero), so the 'descent/compatibility datum ACROSS the family' has no material to glue — the multiplicativity axiom becomes a formal index-bookkeeping label carried by no geometry, i.e. the S1 axiom is formally inserted, not geometrically consumed (the exact Z6 vacuity failure); (d) the total intersection-data class available to any assembly is {constants} ∪ {bilinear cross-terms a_pq·b'_pq + a'_pq·b_pq in per-prime fiber labels} ∪ {per-prime End = Z multiplication-graph data on the diagonal surfaces E_p×E_p (End(E_p) = Z since CM would need log²p ∈ π²Q), whose intersection numbers (Γ_[n]·Δ) = deg([n]−1) are universal polynomials carrying no arithmetic}. The Weil explicit formula's prime side is LINEAR in Λ(p)f(log p); linear prime terms, the archimedean term, and the pole term can enter this data class only by hand-insertion of the answer key into the weights. This is the complete, proven form of the Z5 failure the brief feared ('bandwidth-style data in geometric dress' — in fact worse: the geometric layer contributes nothing at all). N2 as drafted is ill-posed ('enumerate correspondence classes… which combinations of graph classes make (Ψ_f·Δ) reproduce prime terms' — there are no graph classes and no Δ on the off-diagonal surfaces). findings.argument: Re-derivation from the definition: H_t(z) = ∫₀^∞ e^{tu²}Φ(u)cos(zu)du with Φ super-exponentially decaying, so t ↦ H_t is continuous in the locally-uniform topology and each H_t ≢ 0. De Bruijn's monotonicity (all-real zeros at t ⟹ all-real at every t' > t) makes S = {t : H_t has only real zeros} an up-ray; Newman gives S ≠ ℝ, de Bruijn gives S ⊇ [1/2, ∞); Λ := inf S. S is CLOSED at Λ: take t_n ↓ Λ with t_n ∈ S; H_{t_n} → H_Λ locally uniformly, so by Hurwitz every zero of H_Λ is a limit of zeros of H_{t_n}, which are real — hence H_Λ has only real zeros and S = [Λ, ∞). Therefore H_{t₀} has a non-real zero ⟺ t₀ ∉ S ⟺ t₀ < Λ, exactly the brief's biconditional; at t₀ = 0, a non-real zero of H_0 = an off-line zero of ξ gives Λ > 0 immediately. I also re-checked W1's box soundness independently: s = 1 (the only pole) has Re = 1 > σ₂, so ζ'/ζ has residue-sum = zero count in R̄; an enclosure of width < 1/2 contains at most one integer, so it pins the true count m ≥ 1; certified boundary nonvanishing makes the contour integral well-defined and excludes boundary zeros. Sound. Two nits an adjudicator would catch: (1) 'a certified Λ ≥ 10^{−N} is EXACTLY a certified non-real zero of H_{t₀} for some t₀ ≥ 10^{−N}' — only the witness direction holds; if Λ = 10^{−N} exactly, non-real zeros exist only at t₀ < 10^{−N}, so the only-if direction fails at the boundary (harmless: the arm uses only witness ⟹ bound); (2) in W1, 'hence ¬RH, hence (Rodgers–Tao) Λ > 0' — ¬RH ⟹ Λ > 0 is the classical de Bruijn–Newman equivalence (contrapositive of RH ⟺ Λ ≤ 0, i.e., S = [Λ,∞) with H_0 ~ ξ); Rodgers–Tao contributes only Λ ≥ 0 for the RH ⟺ Λ = 0 framing. Both are one-line edits.
